items.title: Defer limen-verify workflow until the first application slice
items.description: limen verify --strict cannot pass (LIMEN010/LIMEN012) while Mercatus has no engine code; remove the tool-installed limen-verify.yml from this change so CI is not red. Owner/coordinator decision on PR #5.

items.title: Add limen-verify and echelon-foundations workflows with the first application slice
items.description: Deferred from PR #5. When the first Limen application slice lands: (1) run 'npx @echelon-foundry/limen@0.7.1 init' to reinstall the tool-owned .github/workflows/limen-verify.yml (absent now, so local limen verify also reports LIMEN007) and point limen.config.json boundary engine/kernel at real paths so limen verify --strict passes; (2) add .github/workflows/echelon-foundations.yml calling kemiller2002/praxis/.github/workflows/foundations-verify.yml with praxis_ref a95dbf238e561eaac4b38ca7011efc1a496cf1c6 (or newer), after adding an F# project referencing EchelonFoundry.Aegis.Core 1.0.0 with Aegis usage and aegis-boundaries.json, and pinned, used @echelon-foundry/design-system 0.4.1 and @echelon-foundry/print-components 0.3.0. Both workflows must be green; no notApplicable or required:false.
